newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.295pts to 103.255.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.295pts to 103.255.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.295 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.255, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.001 points to 2.271 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.271 points to 99.661 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.210 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 14.981 points to 1,032.759.
